# `m.stocks.filings.disclosures_8k`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Disclosures in 8-K current reports, classified by category, one row per disclosure.

```python
m.stocks.filings.disclosures_8k(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| Time range | `start` and `end` are sent as `filing_date.gte` and `filing_date.lte` |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.APPEND`: appends only rows it has not seen, keyed by `AccessionNumber`, `PrimaryCategory`, `SecondaryCategory`, `TertiaryCategory`, `SupportingText` and `Symbol` |
| `sort` | any REST field of the rows (see Massive fields below), or several separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc` |
| `filters` | `cik`, `cik_any_of`, `tertiary_category` |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Material Event Disclosures (8-K) (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The ticker the request named that the row lists in `Tickers`: a row that lists several of the named tickers appears once for each, so an article about AAPL and MSFT read for both is listed under each. A request that named one ticker gives it to every row. Null when the call named no ticker, and on a row that lists none of a request's named tickers. | REST |
| `AccessionNumber` | String | Unique SEC accession number for the filing (e.g., '0000320193-25-000010'). | REST |
| `Cik` | String | SEC Central Index Key of the filer (10 digits, zero-padded). | REST |
| `FilingDate` | String | Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). | REST |
| `FilingUrl` | String | Direct URL to the full submission text file for the filing on SEC EDGAR. | REST |
| `PrimaryCategory` | String | Top-level disclosure category (e.g., 'financial_results'). See the full taxonomy at /stocks/taxonomies/vX/disclosures. | REST |
| `SecondaryCategory` | String | Mid-level disclosure category (e.g., 'earnings_announcement'). See the full taxonomy at /stocks/taxonomies/vX/disclosures. | REST |
| `SupportingText` | String | A verbatim excerpt from the filing text supporting the assigned categories. | REST |
| `TertiaryCategory` | String | Most specific disclosure category (e.g., 'quarterly_results'). Filtering on this column must use an exact match. See the full taxonomy at /stocks/taxonomies/vX/disclosures. | REST |
| `Tickers` | String[] | A list of ticker symbols for the filing company. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes; empty if no ticker is currently mapped to the filer. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
